**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation in either direction, which satisfies the rule's preferred position (no MFN burdening the Customer).

- **Fees / Exhibit B (p0054, p0152–p0154, p0157, p0165–p0168):** Licence, maintenance, MarketSite.net access, implementation and revenue-sharing amounts are fixed negotiated figures. Nothing requires Corio to extend to Commerce One pricing, revenue-share percentages or other terms no less favourable than those given to any third party, and nothing requires Corio to match a third-party offer.
- **Grant of rights (Section 2), Shared Resources, and Exhibit D marketing cooperation:** no price- or terms-matching mechanic; Section 2.4/2.9 leave future licence fees to mutual agreement rather than to an MFN benchmark.
- Targeted searches for "most favored/favourable", "no less favorable", "lowest", "best price", "comparable", "similarly situated", "discount" and "any other customer" all returned no hits.

No walk-away exposure (no open-ended obligation to pass through better third-party terms), so the clause set needs no amendment.
